target.statement: Opus 4.8 Loop (ours) VUS-PR = 53.86 on TSB-AD univariate families (dataset-mean), beating FFT detector 35.00, Spectral Residual 34.75, C22MP 32.01, catch22+Mahalanobis 28.36
target.dataset: TSB-AD univariate families (11 families, Time-RCD 16-family protocol)

compute.basis: Detector is a short NumPy program (Appendix C) run on one CPU core, but reproducing the dataset-mean requires downloading the full TSB-AD univariate suite (11 families, thousands of series), reimplementing the Time-RCD protocol metrics (Aff-F, F1-T, Std-F1, VUS-PR) and the four baseline wrappers, then scoring every series; the detector itself is milliseconds per series.

blockers: TSB-AD data must be fetched and assembled across 11 families
Time-RCD 16-family protocol/metric code (affiliation F, VUS-PR) must be reimplemented or ported
baseline wrappers (FFT, Spectral Residual, C22MP, catch22+Mahalanobis) must be rebuilt to fill the comparison row
anonymized repo may not include the full harness/configs
title: Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series
